procedure: Bind accepted findings, conclusion limits and current metrics.
Synthesize claims, support, mechanism and credible counterarguments.
Bind decision consequences and articulate judgment, conditions and action.
Return arguments, actual acceptance status and unsupported relationships.

acceptance.expectation: Each argument resolves to finding/evidence and current metric/model IDs; acceptance and review metadata cite actual records.
Quantified effects use supported current results and actual decision mechanisms, with reasoned unquantified or inapplicable consequences where needed.
Claim, counterargument, selected judgment and action cohere without exceeding finding limits or turning illustrative/proposed board content into factual approval.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
